rappel.hors-agenda: First add the session to your agenda.
rappel.phrase: The reminder appears at the top of Guide Négo while the app is open, with no sound or notification.

compte.texte: Create an account or sign in to keep this session in your agenda on all your devices. The session itself can be read without an account.
compte.connexion: I already have an account — Sign in

sans-edition.texte: Negotiation sessions will appear here once the next COP is announced.

jamais-lue.titre: Sessions not yet read on this phone
jamais-lue.texte: The negotiation sessions had not been read before the network was lost. They will be read when the connection returns, then stay readable without it.

erreur.titre: The sessions could not be read
erreur.texte: The Guide Négo server did not respond. Try again in a moment.

inconnue.texte: This session is not among the negotiation sessions of this COP.
